meta.source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (state finances) over MoSPI GSDP
meta.coverage: State finances as a share of each state's economy: gross fiscal deficit, revenue deficit, own tax revenue and outstanding liabilities, per cent of GSDP
meta.note: Computed: RBI Handbook Tables 164, 165, 168 (actuals only; budget and revised estimates are left out) and 176 (outstanding liabilities, end of March, used only in years with an actual deficit for that state), in rupees, over MoSPI GSDP at current prices (states-gsdp-current) for the same fiscal year. The RBI's own ratios use the GSDP vintage of its day, so they can differ slightly. A negative revenue deficit is a surplus. Left out as a source error (liabilities several times both neighbouring years): delhi 2014, puducherry 2014, tripura 2014, uttarakhand 2014.
